cycles.resolution: Keep authority axes distinct: task scope, chain dependencies, checkpoint decisions; derive status instead of copying prose.
Manifest resources and dependencies explicitly; agent selects skill, references do not dispatch agents.
Manifest is declared input, validator is independent tool, executable tests remain evidence; no artifact may generate its own expected inventory silently.

One generic grammar with local/domain extensions; legacy validators remain compatibility replay.

H3 defines accepted resource/schema identities before H2 consumes them; run sequentially.
